description.value: EasyStay Inn & Suites is an independent, locally run motel on Highway 3, a short walk from downtown Fernie and a block from the Elk River and the town's walking trails. Some rooms have full kitchens, and there's an indoor pool, a hot tub, and guest laundry. It was formerly the Canadas Best Value Inn.
